description: Source code for CrashReportSender class handling crash report uploads, checkpoint management, and system time retrieval in Windows environment.

classes.name: CrashReportSender
classes.description: Class responsible for sending crash reports, managing checkpoints, and controlling report frequency.

methods.name: SendCrashReport
methods.description: Sends a crash report to the specified URL with given parameters and files, returns result status.

methods.name: ReadCheckpoint
methods.description: Reads checkpoint data from a file to restore last sent date and report count.

methods.name: ReportSent
methods.description: Updates report statistics and checkpoint file after a report is successfully sent.

methods.name: GetCurrentDate
methods.description: Retrieves the current date in YYYYMMDD format based on system time.

methods.name: OpenCheckpointFile
methods.description: Opens the checkpoint file with specified mode, handling platform-specific functions.
